70:t_005:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Nice, nice! It goes perfectly with beer!」

70:t_005:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「For once, I completely agree with $$マオ$$!」

70:t_005:6.en:
$$ラム$$
「But if I eat this much, I think I'll get fat.」

70:t_005:7.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「Shall we go for a swim later? It's the sea, after all, and we have the chance.」

70:t_005:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. It's really delicious.」

70:t_005:10.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I question the necessity of this situation.」

70:t_005:11.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Are you that unhappy about ending up as a stand-in for a hot plate?」

70:t_005:12.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I repeat. I question the necessity of this situation.」

70:t_005:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Shut it, tin can. Your armor is pitch black, so the heat of the sun turns you into a hot plate.」

70:t_005:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I judge that $$ブラックオックス#robot$$ is better suited to the role.」

70:t_005:15.en:
$$アル$$
「$$オックス$$ is a child, after all. Keeping still is out of the question.」

70:t_005:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「I never expected a suggestion of yours to turn out useful. I'll give you credit, $$アル$$.」

70:t_005:17.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The situation is incomprehensible. Its efficiency is also questionable.」

70:t_005:18.en:
$$レド$$
「Never thought a $$マシンキャリバー$$ could be of use for anything besides combat.」

70:t_005:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, I question the necessity of this situation.」

70:t_005:20.en:
$$レド$$
「Necessity has nothing to do with it. The fact is that many people need you right now.」

70:t_005:21.en:
$$レド$$
(Maybe I have that too... Being needed by someone in a way of living other than as a soldier...)

70:t_006:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...The $$ガルガンティア船団$$... It will be a memory I'll never forget...」

70:t_006:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And to protect the peace of this sea as well, we have to go.」

70:t_006:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I hate to part, but I suppose it's time.」

70:t_006:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「What awaits us beyond that is a new battle, isn't it...」

75:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

75:t_1:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hahaha! Looks like you've been doing well, $$ワッ太$$!」

75:t_1:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'll have you know, $$蒼の地球$$ had it rough too!」

75:t_1:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「If you're going to say that, things were rough here on our $$翠の地球$$ too!」

75:t_1:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But we got to meet again like this.」

75:t_1:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah...! Let's blast those $$サイデリアル$$ bastards and drive them off both Earths!」

75:t_1:10.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$恵子$$, were you and the others in Japan on $$翠の地球$$?」

75:t_1:11.en:
$$恵子$$
「Yes. We fought the $$サイデリアル$$ attacking Japan while also working with a resistance group on the Central Continent.」

75:t_1:12.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「It seems we weren't the only ones fighting. Members of the old $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ also seem to be continuing to resist the $$サイデリアル$$ on that continent.」

75:t_1:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「So that's why the $$サイデリアル$$ and the Resistance are evenly matched on that Central Continent?」

75:t_1:14.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Are the crew of the 《$$フリーデン$$》 there too?」

75:t_1:15.en:
$$恵子$$
「We haven't heard anything about $$ジャミル$$ and the others.」

75:t_1:17.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「No need to be disappointed. $$ジャミル$$ and the others are probably on the $$アメリア$$ Continent.」

75:t_1:19.en:
$$恵子$$
「In $$ＡＤＷ$$ terms, it's the North American continent.」

75:t_1:20.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ lost $$セントラル・ベース$$ in the north of the Central Continent, so their most important stronghold on this planet is there now.」

75:t_1:21.en:
$$甲児$$
「In short, it's the $$サイデリアル$$ home base on this Earth.」

75:t_1:22.en:
$$恵子$$
「For detailed information, please look at the message disc from $$万丈$$.」

75:t_1:23.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「On his instructions, we were about to join up with all of you and head for the $$アメリア$$ Continent.」

75:t_1:25.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$万丈$$ seems to be acting on his own, and we don't know where he is right now either.」

75:t_1:26.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's just like him. I'm sure he's shrewdly probing the enemy's movements.」

75:t_1:27.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Then we will take charge of the disc from $$破嵐万丈$$. In all likelihood, we will follow his proposal and head for the $$アメリア$$ Continent too.」

75:t_1:28.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then from now on, we'll be together again.」

75:t_1:29.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah! I'm counting on you, $$ワッ太$$.」

75:t_1:30.en:
$$レド$$
「Let me come along on that journey too.」

75:t_1:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is it to fight the $$サイデリアル$$ as a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$?」

75:t_1:35.en:
$$レド$$
「I want to learn about this world. So that I can go on living.」

75:t_1:37.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「We'll tag along. A journey to get to know that world, right?」

75:t_1:39.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Truth is... we came to see you off meaning to do this from the very start.」

75:t_1:40.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「So that's how it is, you lot. When it comes to repairing machines, I've got a little confidence. Take good care of us!」

75:t_1:41.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well... sure, we're short on hands, so eager new recruits are more than welcome, but...」

75:t_1:42.en:
$$マオ$$
「Are you sure about this, you two? What's waiting where we're headed is a fight, you know.」

75:t_1:43.en:
$$エイミー$$
「I know. But... I want to see this world with my own eyes.」

75:t_1:44.en:
$$レド$$
「Is that all right, $$エイミー$$...? What about $$ベベル$$...」

75:t_1:45.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$ベベル$$ gave me the push I needed... He asked me to set out in his place and tell him what I see and hear.」

75:t_1:47.en:
$$エイミー$$
「That was the wish of $$ベベル$$ and me, and I couldn't drag you into it...」

75:t_1:48.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But now I can say it. Let's go together, $$レド$$.」

75:t_1:52.en:
$$アルト$$
「Another brooding type joins up, huh.」

75:t_1:53.en:
$n
「Let me tell you something, $$アルト$$. The other two aside, I am not a brooding type.」

75:t_1:55.en:
$$アルト$$
「Got it. Thanks to the sun over the $$残されの海$$, smiles have started to suit you guys a little, too.」

75:t_1:56.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then, now that we have new comrades joining us...」
